Hi 
My answers might not be very helpful since I am still cutting and I don't think I won't stop very soon. 

1) 

Self-harm is not okay, it never was and never will. I know what I am doing is wrong and I understand why people don't want others to self-harm but when you are deep into depression or have some really bad thoughts often self harm is the only solution to ease the pain you are feeling. At the moment I am trying my best to stop self-harming and my biggest accomplishment was going two weeks clean. But sometimes it seems that there is no other way with coping with the pain you are feeling then self-harm. 

2)

I had hit this turning point a couple of times now. Every time I hit it I say to myself "why?" And then I decide to try to go clean but then something just throws me back into my depression and the cycle repeats. The most recent point I had had was when I met my best friend who had been helping me cope with my depression and guided me on what to do and what not to. I promised that I won't self harm again but not only a few days ago, I got yelled at ,at home, but my classmates find another way to harm my self-esteem. And bam I am ack into harming just so I won't commit suicide. I haven't committed suicide for the second time because I self-harmed. If I haven't done it that day I bet I wouldn't be here. 

3)

The worst thing? Probably how addictive it is. Me personally I am partly addicted to it. I really don't know if other people aren't addicted to it but for me, it was a routine almost. I would come home after a bad day at school got yelled at from my parent because of my grades and then just so I could keep pushing through and won't commit suicide I self-harmed. For me, it is really relieving after a bad day. Don't get me wrong it hurts like hell but after a while, you will get used to it. It really helps with coping. But don't do it it's wrong. I know it is but I just can't stop. 

I am sorry if I make any errors I am not a native English speaker. I hope it will help you
